Fitzroy River venue approved for 2032 Olympics rowing despite crocodiles

The Fitzroy River in Rockhampton, Australia, has been approved as a venue for the rowing events of the 2032 Brisbane Olympic Games. The river is known to be inhabited by crocodiles. The approval signifies that the venue meets the necessary requirements for hosting the Olympic competition.
